svg.font-family: Hanken Grotesk, Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Seven things that can happen to one piece of context on its way to a task, and why each one lands that way. Text under its cap is kept whole, text over it is trimmed to the cap and measured again from what survived, and when two caps bind equally the reason names the total so a reader can tell the run is nearly out. Empty text is still recorded as a check. A character sitting on the cut is dropped rather than mangled, because the trim is measured in bytes. The marked row is the one where a piece is dropped whole, and even then the record keeps a row for it.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: The trim counts bytes, so a half character decodes away before a task

svg.text: Four numbers ride with every row: bytes and tokens on arrival, bytes and tokens admitted. Tokens are approximate, UTF-8 bytes over four rounded up, so a cap is a
guardrail rather than a measurement. forum context preflight runs the same arithmetic before a model call is spent, and the run record carries the tally.
